title: Bond length, energy and identity correspondence
statement: Bond length and strength are separate source-bounded records paired by one specific bond identity: inter-centre distance and positive dissociation transfer under retained methods and conditions; no universal formula is imported.
generation_rule: Generate the literal product of the registered length/strength carrier, length, strength, conditions, correspondence, measurement, record and extension choices.
grammar_boundary: Every identified bond with one source/method-bounded inter-centre distance record and one separately source/condition-bounded positive dissociation-transfer record, joined only by common bond identity.

choices.name: generic-bond-type-only
choices.reason: A type average can erase the specific molecular carrier.

choices.name: specific-identified-bond
choices.reason: Both records bind to the same bond identity.

choices.name: context-free-distance
choices.reason: Measured bond length depends on method and state.

choices.name: method-bounded-centre-distance
choices.reason: Centres, method, state and uncertainty remain held.

choices.name: qualitative-strong-weak-label
choices.reason: A qualitative label cannot reproduce dissociation.

choices.name: positive-dissociation-transfer
choices.reason: Strength is the registered carrier required to open the bond.

choices.name: conditions-erased
choices.reason: Phase, state and cleavage path affect measured records.

choices.name: measurement-conditions-retained
choices.reason: Every condition remains part of identity.

choices.name: universal-inverse-equation
choices.reason: A categorical relation does not force one universal formula.

choices.name: common-bond-identity-pairing
choices.reason: Length and strength correspond by shared bond carrier only.

choices.name: paired-values-without-provenance
choices.reason: A pair without methods cannot be compared.

choices.name: bond-length-strength-source-trace
choices.reason: Identity, values, methods and uncertainties remain held.

choices.name: free-length-strength-fit
choices.reason: A fitted curve can force measured examples.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: No relation beyond identity pairing is asserted.

induction_base: One identified bond with one method-bounded distance and one condition-bounded dissociation record supplies the first correspondence pair.
induction_step: Appending one measurement retains bond identity, method, conditions and uncertainty without changing the derived structural law or fitting a universal curve.
exclusions: no IUPAC bond definition, orbital equation, electronegativity scale, measured value or V2 answer may select a candidate
no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
no free, fitted, learned or target-derived parameter
no application result or opaque predictor
no universal bond-length/strength formula inferred from a categorical correspondence
official target content opens only through post-seal custody

Every identified bond with one source/method-bounded inter-centre distance record and one separately source/condition-bounded positive dissociation-transfer record, joined only by common bond identity.
operational_witnesses: length and strength records bind to one bond carrier
falsification_condition: The claim fails if IUPAC lacks the registered empirical relationship among bond length, dissociation energy and order, or if a changed row is accepted; it does not fail merely because no universal monotone formula exists.
